text: Sorry, I missed that. I can't read secret values, so I can't count what's in ODDS_API_KEY directly. What I can see is the engine's usage ledger, and it lists 14 distinct Odds API keys, not 21. Of those, 9 are spent and keys 10-14 have only about 15 calls each. If you saved 21 keys, either 7 were never added to the GitHub secret, or the secret was updated after the engine's last start and the running job hasn't re-read it yet. To check: Settings > Cloud scan > Send my API keys to GitHub restarts the engine so it re-reads them, and the next usage ledger should then show 21. I'll confirm the count after that restart. Separately, I'm still fixing the CH6 problem where every key shows usage even though the pool should stay on the first key with credits.
